spec.mathematics: Centre: 10t+30. Clockwise from top left, centre-to-endpoint operations and endpoints are: divide by 2, blank, 5t+20; blank, divide by 5, 2t+1; blank, multiply by 3, 6t+18; divide by 10, blank, 4t+12; blank, subtract 30, 20t+30; add 10, blank, 2t+8.
spec.answerVisibility: All six requested operation circles remain empty. Only source givens are visible.

answer.worked:
Clockwise from top left:

Top left: $+5$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{10t+30}{2}&=5t+15\\(5t+15)+5&=5t+20\end{align*}$$
Top right: $-25$.
$$\begin{align*}(10t+30)-25&=10t+5\\\frac{10t+5}{5}&=2t+1\end{align*}$$
Right: $\div 5$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{10t+30}{5}&=2t+6\\3(2t+6)&=6t+18\end{align*}$$
Bottom right: $\times 4$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{10t+30}{10}&=t+3\\4(t+3)&=4t+12\end{align*}$$
Bottom left: $\times 2$.
$$\begin{align*}2(10t+30)&=20t+60\\(20t+60)-30&=20t+30\end{align*}$$
Left: $\div 5$.
$$\begin{align*}(10t+30)+10&=10t+40\\\frac{10t+40}{5}&=2t+8\end{align*}$$
